key_specs.label: Battery Life
key_specs.value: Up to 20 hours of listening time on a single charge with ANC or Transparency mode

key_specs.label: Charging
key_specs.value: 5 minutes of charge time provides around 1.5 hours of listening time

evidence_excerpts: 1. Testing conducted by Apple in August 2024 using preproduction AirPods Max paired with iPhone 16 Pro Max. Battery life depends on device settings, environment, usage, and many other factors.
2. Personalized Spatial Audio requires compatible hardware and software. Compatible content required in supported apps.
3. 5-minute charge testing conducted with drained AirPods Max; 5-minute charge provided up to 1.5 hours audio playback with volume set to 50%.
4. Storage in the Smart Case preserves battery charge in ultra-low-power state.
5. Lossless Audio requires compatible USB-C wired connection with supported source device.
